parsed.explanation: GE spun off both GE HealthCare (January 2023) and GE Vernova (April 2024), and their historical results were recast as discontinued operations for all periods presented, removing their revenues from the continuing operations income statement figures reported in the newer filing.
parsed.evidence_quote: DISCONTINUED OPERATIONS primarily comprise our former GE Vernova and GE HealthCare businesses... Results of operations, financial position and cash flows for these businesses are reported as discontinued operations for all periods presented and the notes to the financial statements have been adjusted on a retrospective basis.
